faq_heading: North Vancouver schools: your questions answered

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 48 schools with a North Vancouver street address: 35 public schools and 13 independent schools. It also shows 2 college and university campuses. In that list, 12 schools marked as offering French Immersion, 1 Francophone school run by the Conseil scolaire francophone, 1 alternate program and 1 online school.

Public schools here are run by School District 44 (North Vancouver) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone). Count by district: School District 44 (North Vancouver): 34, School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone): 1.
Alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address sit under "other public schools and programs"; the level of every school is read from its name.

Public secondary schools with a North Vancouver address: Argyle Secondary, Carson Graham Secondary, Handsworth Secondary, Mountainside Secondary, Seycove Secondary Community, Sutherland Secondary and Windsor Secondary.

The Ministry file marks these North Vancouver schools as offering French Immersion: Argyle Secondary, Boundary Elementary, Braemar Elementary, Cleveland Elementary, Cousteau L'ecole Francaise Interna'le, Dorothy Lynas Elementary, Handsworth Secondary, Larson Elementary, North Vancouver Online Learning and Ross Road Elementary and 2 more.

Independent schools listed for North Vancouver include Bodwell High School, Brockton Preparatory School, Cousteau L'ecole Francaise Interna'le, Holy Trinity School, Kenneth Gordon and Lions Gate Christian Academy and 7 more.
Before an offer, ask the district which school serves the exact street address.
The North Vancouver school district publishes its catchments as maps (PDF files), not as a list of streets. Use the district's own page to check an address:
North Vancouver school district catchments and school finder
The Conseil scolaire francophone publishes its attendance zones (zones de fréquentation) on its own site:
Conseil scolaire francophone attendance zones

faq.q: How many schools are in North Vancouver, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 48 schools with a North Vancouver street address: 35 public schools and 13 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.

faq.q: Which school district covers North Vancouver?
faq.a: Public schools with a North Vancouver address are run by School District 44 (North Vancouver) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone).

faq.q: How do I find the catchment school for a North Vancouver address?
faq.a: Ask School District 44 (North Vancouver) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone) to confirm it for the exact street address.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
